'''0.27d''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that added support for the upcoming Steam release.

==Changelog==
* Added Steam support
* Fixed some sync issues

==Hotfix 0.27d2==
* Fixed bugs in clans functionality
* Fixed errors in squads functionality
* Fixed searching players by name
* Changed rating calculation (restored the previous system)
